_about: Mirrors chemistry.reactions: Id, Reaction (name), Reactants, Products, Conditions, Rate, Heat, Where, Mark, plus source and formation enthalpies. Heat is J/mol of reaction as written at 298.15 K. Formation values: NBS tables and NIST WebBook CaO, Ca(OH)2, CO2, H2O entries. All seed kinetics are explicitly models, not measured rates.

reactions.name: Carbon combustion

conditions.note: [model] 400 C ignition threshold from the pirate reaction table; charcoal ignition depends on surface and preparation. Complete oxidation only. Does not run below 15% oxygen by volume in the vessel's gas **(Rex, 2026-10-29)**; no opened source for the 15%, so minO2Source is null. The rate by fuel surface and draught is the game's rule, not the engine's.

reactions.mark: [model] Charcoal treated as standard-state carbon; no oxygen-starved branch.

rate.note: [model] Complete within the step above the minimum temperature, limited by reagents and available sensible heat. The cited thermochemical sources supply no applicable bulk first-order Arrhenius parameters.
